title: Woo Ching Ying

page_data.en:
C: I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 223
Date 4/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

1st April 1916.

Sir,
The rebels have become very active recently trying to induce some of the Arsenal troops to join them. It is said that in addition to the troops stationed at Woo Ching Ying 軍營 of whom there are two thousand, there are five hundred troops quartered in Wen Chow Hwan Kwan 徽州會館 whose loyalty is not above suspicion. Woo Ching Ying is near the S.H.R. Station, and Wen Chow Hwan Kwan is between St. Catherine's Bridge and the Arsenal.
Owing to reports that a rising would take place, extraordinary precautions were taken at the Kiangnan Arsenal last night.
The troops at the Arsenal were paid yesterday.
It is said that the Yunnan rebels have sent a telegram to Shanghai requesting a rebel named Wong Tsuh Ming 王則民 to go to Yunnan.
There were rumours current yesterday that the tipans of the large foreign firms in the Settlement have been notified by their Consuls that the rebels were about to attack the Arsenal.
With reference to yesterday's report touching the arrest of two men in the vicinity of the Arsenal with maps in their possession, it has been ascertained that they are natives of Hupeh, named Lieu Sung Hyeu 劉心源 and Tsang Loh Tsiang 張壽 . They were formerly military officers in their native province.
General Wo Fong Ling 何丰林 of Sungkiang visited the Arsenal yesterday. It is said that he reported that the rebels are very active in Sungkiang and asked for more troops.
Three robbers who were concealed in cases in the Settlements were shot at the Arsenal yesterday afternoon.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered mss. apl. 4

C: I. D.
I. O. REG
第 223 号
日期 1916年4月4日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年4月1日。

先生：

叛军近期活动频繁，试图诱使兵工厂的部分士兵加入他们。据说，除了驻扎在吴淞营的两千名士兵外，还有五百名士兵驻扎在徽州会馆，其忠诚度令人怀疑。吴淞营靠近上海北站，徽州会馆位于圣凯瑟琳桥与兵工厂之间。

由于有报告称将发生起义，昨晚江南兵工厂采取了特别的预防措施。

兵工厂的士兵已于昨日领饷。

据悉，云南叛军已向上海发送电报，要求一名名为王则民的叛军前往云南。

昨日流传着这样的谣言：租界内各大洋行的买办已接到各自领事的通知，称叛军即将袭击兵工厂。

关于昨日报告中提及在兵工厂附近逮捕两名持有地图的男子一事，经查实，此二人为湖北籍，名为刘心源和张寿。他们此前曾在原籍担任军官。

松江的何丰林将军昨日访问了兵工厂。据说他报告称叛军在松江活动非常活跃，并请求增派部队。

昨日下午，三名藏身于箱柜中潜入租界的强盗在兵工厂被击毙。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警司。

录入手稿 4月4日
